<parameter name="contents">from enum import Enum

class OrderState(Enum):
    CREATED = "created"
    PAID = "paid"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    REFUNDED = "refunded"

class Order:
    VALID_TRANSITIONS = {
        OrderState.CREATED: {OrderState.PAID, OrderState.CANCELLED},
        OrderState.PAID: {OrderState.SHIPPED, OrderState.REFUNDED, OrderState.CANCELLED},
        OrderState.SHIPPED: {OrderState.DELIVERED, OrderState.CANCELLED},
        OrderState.DELIVERED: {OrderState.REFUNDED},
        OrderState.CANCELLED: set(),
        OrderState.REFUNDED: set(),
    }
    
    def __init__(self, order_id):
        self.order_id = order_id
        self.state = OrderState.CREATED
    
    def transition(self, new_state):
        if new_state not in self.VALID_TRANSITIONS[self.state]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Cannot transition from {self.state.value} to {new_state.value}"
            )
        self.state = new_state
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Order({self.order_id}, state={self.state.value})"

# Demo
if __name__ == "__main__":
    order = Order("ORD-001")
    print(order)
    
    order.transition(OrderState.PAID)
    print(order)
    
    order.transition(OrderState.SHIPPED)
    print(order)
    
    order.transition(OrderState.DELIVERED)
    print(order)
    
    order.transition(OrderState.REFUNDED)
    print(order)
    
    # Invalid transition
    try:
        order.transition(OrderState.PAID)
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
